en-US.subtitle: Find passengers, name a fare
en-US.promotional_text: Find passengers between Kabul, Parwan and Ghorband: see the fare they ask, answer with your own, and drive with warnings about the road ahead.
en-US.description:
VELRO Driver is the driver's side of VELRO, the intercity ride service between Kabul, Parwan and Ghorband.

Passengers name the price they want to pay for a seat. You see their requests and answer with your own fare. When a passenger picks your offer, the trip is yours.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Go online to see the passengers who are waiting: where they are going, the day and hour, how many seats, and the fare they are asking.
• Accept the asking fare in one tap, or offer your own, with a note for the passenger.
• Keep each trip on one card: the booking, a button to call the passenger, and each passenger's boarding code to check before you leave.
• Drive with the ride map: your route, and warnings about curves and dangerous stretches of the road ahead.
• See what you earn by day, week and month, your trips, VELRO's commission, and what has been settled.
• Send your driving licence, tazkira and car papers from your phone, and follow their review.
• Get help fast: emergency numbers you can call without internet, and a report straight to VELRO.
• Use the app in Dari, Pashto or English.

HOW IT WORKS
Your phone number is your account: you sign in with a one-time code, with no password. Passengers pay you in cash; there are no payments in the app. Your documents and your car are reviewed before you can go online. While you carry a trip, the app uses your location, also with the phone in your pocket, to show your car to the passengers you are driving and to warn you about the road ahead; iOS shows this in the status bar, and it stops when the trip ends. You can delete your account from inside the app at any time (Profile → Delete account).

WHERE
VELRO serves Kabul, Parwan and Ghorband.

review.notes:
VELRO Driver is the driver app of VELRO, an intercity ride service for Kabul, Parwan and Ghorband (Afghanistan). Passengers use the separate VELRO Ride app to name a price; drivers answer with offers. Fares are paid in cash; there are no in-app purchases.

SIGN IN
1. The app opens in Dari. Tap "English" on the sign-in screen.
2. Phone number: +1 202 555 0142 (type the +). Tap "Send code".
3. The code fills in by itself for this review number (no SMS is sent). Tap "Sign in".

This review account is an approved test driver with a registered car, so you can use the whole app. A new driver who signs up must first send documents and a car, and wait for approval by VELRO staff.

WHAT TO TRY
1. Home: turn the "Offline" switch on. Passengers waiting appear under it; "Passengers waiting" opens the board, where you can offer a fare or agree to the one asked. Requests from real passengers are in Afghanistan, so during review the board may be empty; the attached video shows a full trip recorded against our test server.
2. A trip: when a passenger accepts your fare the trip appears on Home with each passenger's boarding code check, a call button, and one button for the next step. When you start the trip the screen becomes the ride map with road warnings.
3. Location: used only while you carry a trip, to show your car to your passengers and warn you about the road; iOS shows it in the status bar and it stops when the trip ends.
4. Your documents / Your vehicle: the papers VELRO has checked, and where a driver sends a photo of each (camera or photo library). Please do not send new photos on this review account: a new photo goes back to VELRO for checking, and until then the account cannot go online.
5. The person icon (Profile) → "Privacy policy", and "Delete account" → "Delete my account".

Privacy policy: https://api.velro.linumic.com/privacy
